label: thm:toric-diophantine-stoichiometry
title: Diophantine reaction kernel, Hess's law, toric binomials, and canonical stoichiometric circuits
html:
Let A_{\mathrm{chem}} \in \mathbb{Z}^{E imes M} be the elemental stoichiometry matrix of M molecular species over E conserved Layer-\mathcal{L}_2 nuclear elements, and let R be any commutative ring [deloera-hemmecke-koeppe2013, sturmfels-thomas1997, craciun-dickenstein-shiu-sturmfels2009].

  1. Diophantine kernel and lattice closure: Unsigned reactant and product multiplicities u_-, u_+ \in \mathbb{N}^M conserve every element (\sum_{j=1}^M A_{\mathrm{chem},ej} u_{-,j} = \sum_{j=1}^M A_{\mathrm{chem},ej} u_{+,j} for all e) if and only if the signed stoichiometric vector v := u_+ - u_- satisfies A_{\mathrm{chem}} v = 0. For all v_1, v_2 \in \ker_{\mathbb{Z}}(A_{\mathrm{chem}}) and a, b \in \mathbb{Z}, a v_1 + b v_2 \in \ker_{\mathbb{Z}}(A_{\mathrm{chem}}), reaction enthalpy \Delta H(v) := h_f(v) satisfies \Delta H(a v_1 + b v_2) = a\,\Delta H(v_1) + b\,\Delta H(v_2) = ar{h}_f(y)(a v_1 + b v_2) for all elemental reference potentials y \in R^E, and every sequence of balanced reactions preserves A_{\mathrm{chem}} n = b.
  2. Toric binomial vanishing: For every balanced reaction u_+ - u_- \in \ker_{\mathbb{Z}}(A_{\mathrm{chem}}) and every elemental fugacity tuple t \in (R^ imes)^E, the monomial evaluation x_j(t) := \prod_{e=1}^E t_e^{A_{\mathrm{chem},ej}} satisfies 
      x(t)^{
u_+} - x(t)^{
u_-} = 0.
  3. Canonical rank-1 primitive circuits: The integer kernels \ker_{\mathbb{Z}}(A_{\mathrm{chem}}) of water synthesis (\mathrm{H}_2,\mathrm{O}_2,\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}), methane combustion (\mathrm{CH}_4,\mathrm{O}_2,\mathrm{CO}_2,\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}), Haber–Bosch ammonia synthesis (\mathrm{N}_2,\mathrm{H}_2,\mathrm{NH}_3), and glucose respiration (\mathrm{C}_6\mathrm{H}_{12}\mathrm{O}_6,\mathrm{O}_2,\mathrm{CO}_2,\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}) are free rank-1 \mathbb{Z}-modules generated respectively by the primitive circuits (-2,-1,2), (-1,-2,1,2), (-1,-3,2), and (-1,-6,6,6).
  4. Complete \mathbb{Z}-basis of the seven-species \mathrm{C} ext{--}\mathrm{H} ext{--}\mathrm{O} network: On (\mathrm{C},\mathrm{H}_2,\mathrm{O}_2,\mathrm{CO},\mathrm{CO}_2,\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O},\mathrm{CH}_4), \ker_{\mathbb{Z}}(A_{\mathrm{CHO}}) \cong \mathbb{Z}^4 is spanned over \mathbb{Z} by water–gas shift (0,1,0,-1,1,-1,0), Boudouard disproportionation (1,0,0,-2,1,0,0), carbon-monoxide methanation (0,-3,0,-1,0,1,1), and carbon oxidation (-1,0,-1,0,1,0,0).
